name: Cards
tagline: Keeps a crowded credit-card wallet honest: expiring credits, fee math
description: Built for people carrying more cards than they can track. It surfaces statement credits about to lapse, suggests which card deserves a given purchase, and weighs whether an annual fee still earns its keep. Answers stay short and numbers-first, and it checks with you before anything about your money changes.
author: stevenvillarino
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
